data_policy: No proprietary search/rank/backlink metrics, service capability, product status or proof was invented. Read the provenance and data-required fields before publishing.

audit.finding: The public homepage visibly states “Website Still Under Construction. Thank you!!!”.
audit.business_impact: International buyers may exit before evaluating the offer; promotion before removal wastes spend and outreach.
audit.required_action: Remove the banner and every construction-template remnant before indexing, campaigns, directories or outreach.

audit.finding: Visible client-logo alt text says “Brand Name : Brand Short Description Type Here.” and one logo is Hiver’s own; prompt v2 documents demo testimonials.
audit.evidence: Live homepage inspection, 14 August 2026, https://hiver.com.np/; named testimonial list is client-provided ground truth pending full source crawl.
audit.business_impact: Placeholder proof materially damages trust and may create consumer-protection and reputational risk.
audit.required_action: Remove all placeholder testimonials, logos, client claims and Review/AggregateRating schema. Reintroduce only named, permissioned, verified evidence.

audit.finding: The live homepage DOM contained 79 raw href="#" anchors, including primary service and industry navigation.
audit.business_impact: The site is effectively a template-led one-page surface; crawlers and users cannot follow a reliable commercial architecture.
audit.required_action: Replace every placeholder link with real URL destinations, then crawl staging/production to prevent orphans and broken internal paths.

audit.finding: The site uses the Nepal country-code namespace .com.np, while the single-word Hiver entity is visibly occupied by an established customer-service SaaS company at hiverhq.com.
audit.evidence: Google international guidance; live inspection of https://hiverhq.com/ on 14 August 2026; RDAP snapshot in domain_status.csv.
audit.business_impact: International commercial targeting and branded discovery face a location signal and entity-disambiguation constraint.
audit.required_action: Complete a domain/brand decision before final URL migration. Obtain qualified trademark review for US/AU/UK before rebrand or major international investment.

audit.finding: Live assets identify WordPress with Elementor 4.1.4 and Elementor Pro 3.28.3.
audit.business_impact: Template/plugin bloat and rendering choices must be addressed in the performance plan; the current site cannot be treated as platform-neutral.
audit.required_action: Run plugin/theme audit; retain Elementor short term only with asset controls and caching, or move the marketing surface to a lightweight block theme after a costed proof of concept.

audit.finding: Visible live service labels are Web Applications, Mobile Apps, Responsive Websites, CRM Web Applications, UI/UX Design and Digital Marketing. No public Shopify, SEO, email or automation service pages were observed.
audit.business_impact: The previous package treated aspirational services as launch-ready commercial pages. This risks misrepresentation and unqualified demand.
audit.required_action: Use the Capability Gate. Do not publish Shopify, SEO, email or automation service pages until Hiver confirms delivery capability, proof, staffing and sales process.

audit.finding: The footer lists School Management, Dental Management, Clinic Management, HR Software and Employee Management, but the product hub was empty in the prior crawl.
audit.evidence: Live homepage inspection 14 August 2026; current sitemap audit, 14 August 2026.
audit.business_impact: Potentially differentiated product opportunities are invisible and cannot be evaluated as agency versus product revenue lines.
audit.required_action: Create a product evidence pack: legal ownership, live/licensable status, deployment count, ICP, markets, pricing, integrations, security, support and permissioned proof.

audit.finding: Live copy contains visible template/generic language and errors including “Transfering”, “Developemnt”, “help’s” and “Insitagram”; author identity is reported as superadmin.
audit.evidence: Live homepage inspection 14 August 2026; superadmin metadata is client-provided ground truth pending CMS export.
audit.business_impact: Low credibility for high-consideration B2B buyers and poor E-E-A-T signals.
audit.required_action: Replace template copy, proofread all pages, use real author/reviewer entities and document the editorial workflow.

audit.finding: Existing articles sit at root URLs while /insights/ also exists; 58 sitemap URLs were observed, mostly media assets, with only a small set of public content pages.
audit.evidence: Current sitemap audit, 14 August 2026, stored in current_site_inventory.csv.
audit.business_impact: A rebuild without a redirect register risks losing existing content URLs and generating crawl confusion.
audit.required_action: Produce URL-by-URL redirect map, retain relevant root-post URLs or redirect 301 to the closest rebuilt insight.

audit.finding: No GSC, GA4, rank data, server/CWV data or commercial funnel data was supplied.
audit.evidence: No client exports or access were supplied to this engagement.
audit.business_impact: Current rankings, traffic, lead quality, country performance and ROI cannot be assessed or forecast.
audit.required_action: Verify Search Console and GA4 before launch; implement CRM closed-loop attribution and obtain baseline data.

domain_options.option: Keep .com.np as the only primary domain
domain_options.cost: Sunk / renewal cost: DATA REQUIRED FROM HIVER
domain_options.geo_and_entity_effect: Google documents ccTLDs as a strong country signal. A Nepal-focused domain does not prevent global ranking, but it adds a locale signal and reinforces an offshore/entity challenge for US/AU/UK head terms.
domain_options.seo_cost: No migration volatility; higher international-positioning friction remains.
domain_options.recommendation: Not recommended as the sole international brand domain if Hiver intends to make US/AU/UK a major acquisition market.

domain_options.option: Migrate same Hiver Technology brand to an available gTLD
domain_options.availability: hivertechnology.com: RDAP registered/reserved. hiver.tech: RDAP not found and registrar presented available; registrar confirmation required.
domain_options.cost: DATA REQUIRED — current registrar quote, premium status, renewal rate, tax, privacy and legal clearance.
domain_options.brand_collision: Still unresolved; changing TLD does not remove the established Hiver SaaS entity collision.
domain_options.geo_and_entity_effect: A gTLD removes the country-code domain signal, but does not create authority or entity distinction.
domain_options.seo_cost: One-time migration and recovery risk; requires redirects, canonical transition, Change of Address, sitemap, backlink updates and monitoring.
domain_options.recommendation: Only pursue if trademark counsel approves retaining the name and Hiver accepts that brand confusion remains.

domain_options.option: Adopt a distinctive international brand on a gTLD; redirect .com.np
domain_options.availability: New naming and domain research required.
domain_options.cost: DATA REQUIRED — naming, trademark counsel, registrar quote, design and migration budget.
domain_options.brand_collision: Best strategic option to remove the direct Hiver entity collision if a distinctive legally-cleared name is selected.
domain_options.geo_and_entity_effect: A distinctive gTLD brand gives the clearest entity-building path for international markets.
domain_options.seo_cost: Highest one-time brand and migration cost; lower long-term navigational ambiguity if executed consistently.
domain_options.recommendation: PROVISIONALLY RECOMMENDED subject to qualified trademark review, commercial approval and a full naming process.

domain_options.option: Retain .com.np for Nepal; launch a distinct gTLD international brand separately
domain_options.cost: DATA REQUIRED — dual-brand operating cost and legal review.
domain_options.brand_collision: Reduced only if the international name is distinctive.
domain_options.geo_and_entity_effect: Separates Nepal domestic and international positioning but creates ongoing content, proof and governance complexity.
domain_options.seo_cost: Avoids a forced migration of Nepal URLs, but requires separate content, entity and backlink programs.
domain_options.recommendation: Viable only if Hiver has distinct product/service and operational capacity for two brands; otherwise avoid split focus.

brand_options.path: Keep “Hiver Technology” and use exact phrase everywhere
brand_options.advantages: Lowest immediate operating cost; retains existing legal entity/domain continuity.
brand_options.costs: Cannot treat “Hiver” as a KPI; ongoing entity confusion; may limit branded SERP clarity; qualified legal review remains essential.
brand_options.SEO_impact: Use Hiver Technology / Hiver Technology Nepal in titles, Organization name, author profiles, directory profiles and press. Never target Hiver alone.
brand_options.next_gate: Trademark review in US/AU/UK; entity profile cleanup.

brand_options.advantages: Strongest long-term entity distinction; supports a clean gTLD and unambiguous branded search.
brand_options.costs: Naming, legal, domain, brand, migration, directory and customer-communication cost.
brand_options.SEO_impact: Short-term volatility and brand reset; potentially cleaner long-term entity/brand retrieval.
brand_options.next_gate: Qualified trademark and naming clearance; name/domain availability; stakeholder approval.

brand_options.path: Use Hiver as a product/service family only
brand_options.costs: Does not resolve international entity overlap and may increase confusion.
brand_options.next_gate: Do not implement without qualified legal advice.

technical.implementation: Remove under-construction banner, all placeholder testimonials/logos/alt text, generic template copy and # links before launch. Do not retain review markup.
technical.acceptance: Production crawl has zero construction text, placeholder testimonial identifiers, generic logo alt text or href="#" navigation.

technical.implementation: Select one primary HTTPS host and trailing-slash policy. Enforce one-hop 301 redirects and self-referencing canonical tags on indexable URLs.
technical.acceptance: Crawl confirms one canonical response per indexable page and no chains.

technical.implementation: Do not finalize URL architecture until leadership resolves keep/migrate/rebrand. For a gTLD migration: URL inventory → 1:1 301 map → staging crawl → update canonicals, hreflang only if applicable, analytics, GSC verification/Change of Address, sitemap, key links and brand assets.
technical.acceptance: Migration register is approved, every legacy URL has one target, and daily GSC/analytics monitoring plan exists.

technical.implementation: Inventory theme, Elementor/Pro, all plugins, templates, widgets, fonts and third-party scripts. Remove unused plugins/widgets, minimize widget nesting, disable unused Elementor assets/experiments where compatible, replace decorative motion and duplicate carousels.
technical.acceptance: Plugin/asset register approved; no unused plugin or unnecessary third-party script remains on P0 templates.

technical.implementation: Short term: retain Elementor only with page caching, asset reduction and template discipline. Midterm: prototype a lightweight WordPress block-theme marketing template. Use headless only if real product/application requirements justify its operating cost.
technical.acceptance: Decision memo compares implementation cost, editing workflow, CWV field data, accessibility, release process and maintenance burden.

technical.implementation: Measure field data separately on mobile and desktop. Google documents good thresholds of LCP ≤2.5s, INP ≤200ms and CLS ≤0.1 at the 75th percentile. Use CrUX/Search Console plus real-user monitoring; do not promise a score before data exists.
technical.acceptance: Baseline and post-launch field report with page-template segmentation.

technical.implementation: Assess hosting for international latency; use CDN edge delivery, full-page cache, object cache if database load warrants it, WebP/AVIF, srcset, reserved dimensions, lazy-load below fold but exclude LCP media, font subsetting/font-display, critical CSS and deferred nonessential JS.
technical.acceptance: Mobile template tests show no obvious render-blocking or layout-shift regressions; field monitoring is active.

technical.implementation: Create segmented XML sitemaps containing canonical indexable pages only. Use robots.txt to permit essential public assets and block only appropriate private/duplicate areas. Noindex internal search, thank-you, staging and low-value archive/tag pages as appropriate after a crawl review.
technical.acceptance: Sitemap, robots, noindex, canonical and indexability checks pass on staging and production.

technical.implementation: Map all existing root-level posts, /insights/, /products/, /services/, /portfolio/, /team/, /about-us/ and any media-related paths to the closest relevant new URL; use one-hop 301s only.
technical.acceptance: Redirect map covers the current URL inventory; no redirect chain, mass-home redirect or unresolved 404 for legacy indexable content.

technical.implementation: Build semantic headings/landmarks, keyboard navigation, visible focus, contrast, labeled forms/errors, target size, reduced-motion behavior, accessible menus and meaningful alt text. Obtain qualified audit before compliance claims.
technical.acceptance: Automated and manual keyboard/screen-reader test log exists; do not claim legal compliance without qualified validation.

technical.implementation: Organization and WebSite only with verified real data; LocalBusiness only for the real Nepal location; BreadcrumbList for deep pages; Service only confirmed services; SoftwareApplication only verified products; Article/BlogPosting only real authors; no Review/AggregateRating on placeholders.
technical.acceptance: Rich Results/Schema validation has no material errors and each markup field matches visible text.

technical.implementation: Verify GSC and Bing Webmaster properties, GA4/GTM, consent controls, heatmap/session tool if approved, WordPress update policy, backups, WAF, spam protection, form routing and incident owner.
technical.acceptance: Named owner, documented configuration and test events exist before campaign launch.

ai_search.what_is_verified: Google says pages eligible for Search snippets can be eligible supporting links; no additional technical requirement is stated. It emphasizes crawlability, internal linking, textual content, page experience and matching structured data.
ai_search.test_status: One Google Nepal product SERP showed an AI Overview with +8 sources. US product SERP capture was blocked by CAPTCHA.
ai_search.recommendation: Fix the crawlable site first; publish factual original decision pages and product/service pages with extractable answers; track Search Console, which includes AI-feature traffic in Web reporting.
ai_search.avoid: Do not create AI-only FAQ/schema content or claim AI Overview placement.

ai_search.what_is_verified: OpenAI documents that web search responses can show source links and that publishers can choose to appear.
ai_search.test_status: Direct query/citation testing was not completed in this session; record as DATA REQUIRED — manual controlled test.
ai_search.recommendation: Allow the appropriate crawler if Hiver’s policy permits; publish original sourced content, real entity signals and clear titles/answers; log citations/referrals rather than promise placement.
ai_search.avoid: Do not block discovery accidentally or represent untested citations as rankings.

ai_search.what_is_verified: Perplexity states its answers include citations and it maintains a publisher program.
ai_search.test_status: Direct query/citation testing was not completed in this session; record as DATA REQUIRED — manual controlled test.
ai_search.recommendation: Create verifiable first-party assets worth citing: implementation checklists, product comparisons, original data/process pages and source-rich explainers.
ai_search.avoid: Do not treat inclusion as controllable or guaranteed.

ai_search.what_is_verified: No direct Gemini citation test completed.
ai_search.recommendation: Apply the same technical/content/entity foundations; maintain a query/source test log quarterly.
ai_search.avoid: No claim of Gemini visibility until observed.

trust_plan.action: Publish named team members, accurate roles, original photos, credible experience and author/reviewer profiles.
trust_plan.dependency: DRH — people, permission, role and biography evidence.

trust_plan.action: Launch 3–5 detailed, permissioned cases instead of a logo wall. Show situation, scope, delivery, approved visuals and measured outcomes with timeframes.
trust_plan.dependency: DRH — client permissions, factual metrics and contracts.

trust_plan.action: Create a factual Nepal-based international-delivery page covering timezone overlap, communication cadence, named contact, contract, payment, NDA, IP assignment, data handling and escalation.
trust_plan.dependency: DRH — actual commitments, processes and legal terms.

trust_plan.action: Prioritize factual profiles on Clutch, GoodFirms/DesignRush where relevant, LinkedIn and Shopify Partner Directory only after eligibility. Gather reviews only from real clients without incentives for positive ratings.
trust_plan.dependency: DRH — eligibility, legal entity, approved portfolio, real review contacts.

trust_plan.action: Use exact legal/brand name consistently; complete Organization sameAs with real profiles; improve LinkedIn company/founder information; consider Crunchbase only if factual; secure real partner/client citations.
trust_plan.dependency: DRH — verified profiles, legal name, logo and official URLs.

trust_plan.action: Do not claim awards, partners, global offices, security certifications, compliance, reviews or results without evidence.

measurement.metrics: Indexation errors, crawl errors, form delivery, broken links, page speed regressions, spam, unresolved redirects.
Impressions, clicks, CTR, country/device/landing page, query groups, conversions, qualified leads, proposals, wins, sales feedback.
measurement.action: Prioritize by qualified demand, not traffic alone.

measurement.metrics: Capability coverage, pipeline by service/product/country, content ROI, backlink/reputation progress, authority-gap evidence, risk register.
measurement.action: Expand only clusters with real fit and delivery capacity.

risks.evidence: Google states ccTLDs are a strong country signal.
risks.mitigation: Resolve a distinctive gTLD/rebrand decision before international rollout; if retained, focus first on Nepal/product/relationship channels and globally useful non-geo content.

risks.evidence: Established Hiver SaaS site is live with 10,000+ teams claim and broad entity footprint.
risks.mitigation: Use full brand phrase; do not optimize for Hiver alone; commission qualified trademark review; evaluate rebrand.

risks.evidence: Construction banner, placeholder logo alt text and generic trust section observed.
risks.mitigation: Remove in Phase 0; reinstate only verified proof.

risks.evidence: No public Shopify/SEO/automation pages observed; team/service proof not supplied.
risks.mitigation: Apply capability gate; block pages until evidence and sales readiness exist.

risks.evidence: Product names listed in footer but product hub empty in prior crawl.

risks.mitigation: Fewer pages, named expertise, original examples, proof and strict page-purpose gate.
Set cadence only after capacity audit; stop at P0 until owners are named.

risks.evidence: US/AU/UK directory counts and established specialist competitors observed in v1 research.
risks.mitigation: Target conditional Tier-A decision content, real proof, directories and relationship-led links first; use paid/routing/outbound where Tier D.

provenance.label: [VERIFIED-TOOL]
provenance.meaning: Evidence from a named tool with the tool and retrieval date recorded.

provenance.label: [VERIFIED-GSC]
provenance.meaning: Evidence from Hiver’s Google Search Console export. Not available in this package.

provenance.label: [SERP-OBSERVED]
provenance.meaning: Directly observed in a country-specific public SERP, with query, country, date and URL/reference recorded.

provenance.label: [PUBLIC-EST]
provenance.meaning: A public, non-proprietary source; not a substitute for paid-tool metrics.

provenance.label: [MODELLED]
provenance.meaning: A transparent calculation or prioritization proxy with the method recorded.

provenance.label: [STRATEGIC-JUDGEMENT]
provenance.meaning: A recommendation based on evidence and commercial reasoning, not a claimed metric.

provenance.label: [DATA REQUIRED]
provenance.meaning: A decision, number or proof asset that Hiver or a paid platform must supply before action.
